Charlie Puth's "How Long" reached #21 on the Billboard Hot 100. "How Long" is a song recorded and produced by American singer-songwriter Charlie Puth.

The song peaked at #21 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 23 weeks on the chart.

How Long was released in 2018.
